summary_cn: 饮料公司英坦妮尔正加强营销力度，强调使用优质原料的同时保持平民价格。该公司计划开拓规模达800亿泰铢的泰国饮料市场，通过「好品质、好价格」的双重优势吸引消费者重复购买，解决市场品牌认知不足的问题。

title: Egco increases stake in US power plant
desc: Electricity Generating Plc (Egco) has increased its investment in the US by acquiring an additional 12% stake in the Linden Cogen natural gas-fired power plant in the state of New Jersey, raising its total ownership to 50%.
title_cn: EGCO增持美国电力项目股份至50%
summary_cn: 泰国电力生成公司(EGCO)增加了在美国的投资，新增收购林登联合热电(Linden Cogen)项目12%的股份，该项目位于美国新泽西州(New Jersey)，专注天然气发电。EGCO在该项目的总持股比例上升至50%，进一步扩大了在北美能源市场的布局。
desc_original: Electricity Generating Plc (Egco) has increased its investment in the US by acquiring an additional 12% stake in the Linden Cogen natural gas-fired power plant in the state of New Jersey, raising its total ownership to 50%.

desc: AMBASSADOR PROGRAM PACKAGE All NEW Mitsubishi PAJERO เปิดรับจองตั้งแต่วันที่ 19 ตุลาคม ถึง 31 ธันวาคม 2569 เป็นการปรับตำแหน่งผลิตภัณฑ์กับโครงสร้างราคาอย่างชัดเจนเพื่อการรุกตลาดเอสยูวีในไทย
title_cn: 新款三菱帕杰罗(Mitsubishi PAJERO)三款车型定价 选哪款最划算
summary_cn: 三菱汽车推出全新帕杰罗车型，自10月19日起至12月31日期间接受预订。新车推出「品牌大使项目」优惠组合，通过调整产品定位和价格体系，旨在强化三菱在泰国SUV市场的竞争力，满足不同消费层级的购车需求。

title: BDMS invests in gene therapy
desc: Bangkok Dusit Medical Services Plc (BDMS) has invested 170 million baht in General Network Photonics Thailand, a developer of gene therapy for leukaemia treatment, as the hospital group seeks to expand access to advanced cancer care and lower treatment costs.
title_cn: BDMS投资1.7亿泰铢发展白血病基因疗法
summary_cn: 泰国三立医疗集团（BDMS）投资1.7亿泰铢给泰国通用网络光子公司，该公司致力于白血病的基因疗法研发。此举旨在扩大先进癌症治疗的可及性，同时降低患者治疗成本，标志着泰国医疗科技的进一步突破。
desc_original: Bangkok Dusit Medical Services Plc (BDMS) has invested 170 million baht in General Network Photonics Thailand, a developer of gene therapy for leukaemia treatment, as the hospital group seeks to expand access to advanced cancer care and lower treatment costs.

title: Pushing the limits
desc: Strapping his feet to a rowing machine, Vasupol Leerungruang pulled the handles to his chest, leaned forward on the return and repeated the rhythm. In front of him was a monitor that tracked and compared his progress with others. This was part of his training to ensure he is in the best shape possible to compete in next year's Hyrox World Championships in Hong Kong.
title_cn: 泰国赛手Vasupol备战Hyrox世界锦标赛
summary_cn: 泰国健身爱好者Vasupol Leerungruang正在进行赛艇机训练，备战明年在香港举办的Hyrox世界锦标赛。他利用带监测功能的设备进行训练，实时对比自己的进度与其他选手成绩，全力确保身体处于最佳竞技状态。
desc_original: Strapping his feet to a rowing machine, Vasupol Leerungruang pulled the handles to his chest, leaned forward on the return and repeated the rhythm. In front of him was a monitor that tracked and compared his progress with others. This was part of his training to ensure he is in the best shape possible to compete in next year's Hyrox World Championships in Hong Kong.

title: Central bank seeks feedback on Buy Now, Pay Later rules
desc: The Bank of Thailand is seeking public feedback on proposed regulations governing "Buy Now, Pay Later" (BNPL) lending to curb rising household debt. The proposed rules include a minimum user age of 20 and a maximum effective interest rate of 15% per year.
title_cn: 泰国央行就「先买后付」监管规则征求意见
summary_cn: 泰国央行正就「先买后付」（BNPL）贷款的监管规则向公众征求意见，旨在遏制家庭债务上升。拟定规则要求用户最低年龄20岁，最高年利率不超过15%。这项政策调整将影响消费者的分期付款选择和金融成本。
desc_original: The Bank of Thailand is seeking public feedback on proposed regulations governing "Buy Now, Pay Later" (BNPL) lending to curb rising household debt. The proposed rules include a minimum user age of 20 and a maximum effective interest rate of 15% per year.

title: Chinese travel alert unlikely to affect arrivals this year
desc: Despite another travel alert issued to Chinese citizens regarding job scams in Thailand, the Tourism Authority of Thailand (TAT) and the Association of Thai Travel Agents (Atta) say it will not affect tourists in general, with arrivals expected to improve to 5-5.5 million this year, as the warning is addressed to high-profile individuals in particular.
title_cn: 中国发布赴泰警示　泰国旅游局称不影响整体客流
summary_cn: 中国再次向国民发布赴泰旅游警示，涉及求职诈骗问题。泰国旅游局（TAT）和泰国旅行社协会（Atta）表示此警示主要针对高知名度人士，不会对普通游客造成影响。泰国今年游客到来预计改善至500-550万人次。
desc_original: Despite another travel alert issued to Chinese citizens regarding job scams in Thailand, the Tourism Authority of Thailand (TAT) and the Association of Thai Travel Agents (Atta) say it will not affect tourists in general, with arrivals expected to improve to 5-5.5 million this year, as the warning is addressed to high-profile individuals in particular.

title: French protests seen threatening Thai tourism
desc: Tourism operators are worried about the mass protests in France, which could eventually affect its economy and further weaken inbound travel to Thailand from Europe, already affected by the persistent unrest in the Middle East.
title_cn: 法国示威游行恐威胁泰国旅游业
summary_cn: 泰国旅游业者担忧法国大规模示威游行可能影响其经济，进一步削弱欧洲游客赴泰的热情。欧洲客源已因中东地区持续动荡而承压，法国局势将加剧这一压力。
desc_original: Tourism operators are worried about the mass protests in France, which could eventually affect its economy and further weaken inbound travel to Thailand from Europe, already affected by the persistent unrest in the Middle East.

title: New Cold War tests Thai choices
desc: A new Cold War is emerging as the United States and China compete from trade and finance to outer space, scholars and senior journalists have warned, urging Thailand not to pick sides too soon.
title_cn: 新冷战考验泰国抉择
summary_cn: 学者及资深记者警告，美国和中国正在贸易、金融乃至太空等多个领域展开激烈竞争，形成新冷战格局。专家呼吁泰国应谨慎应对，不应过早选边站队。该观点深刻反映了泰国在当今大国博弈中的战略地位，也凸显了泰国外交政策面临的复杂抉择和挑战。
desc_original: A new Cold War is emerging as the United States and China compete from trade and finance to outer space, scholars and senior journalists have warned, urging Thailand not to pick sides too soon.

title: House re-invites MP Suchada to explain gambling claims
desc: A House committee will again invite Bhumjaithai MP Suchada Zhang Thaensap and her husband to explain alleged links to online gambling and a reported bribery offer at its meeting on Thursday, chairman Rangsiman Rome said on Monday.
title_cn: 国会再次传唤议员素查达说明赌博指控
summary_cn: 国会委员会将再次邀请人民力量党议员素查达·张腾萨普及其夫婿，在周四会议上就其与线上赌博的疑似关联以及报道中提及的贿赂提议作出说明和回应。此事涉及泰国政治廉洁建设和执法公信力，引发外界对议会制度的关注和监督。
desc_original: A House committee will again invite Bhumjaithai MP Suchada Zhang Thaensap and her husband to explain alleged links to online gambling and a reported bribery offer at its meeting on Thursday, chairman Rangsiman Rome said on Monday.

title: New pilot zone to curb bribery
desc: The government will use Bangkok's Khao San Road as a pilot zone to tackle bribery involving entertainment venues and speed up action against corrupt officials.
title_cn: 曼谷推出反贿赂试点区
summary_cn: 泰国政府将以曼谷考山路（Khao San Road）为试点区域，集中打击与娱乐场所相关的贿赂行为，并加快对腐败官员的问责速度。此举旨在改善政府形象和投资环境，对外国游客和商人的安全及体验具有重要意义，也充分反映了政府的反腐决心。
desc_original: The government will use Bangkok's Khao San Road as a pilot zone to tackle bribery involving entertainment venues and speed up action against corrupt officials.

title: Minister orders checks over pollution complaints
desc: Industry Minister Varawut Silpa-archa on Monday ordered further factory inspections and water sampling in Prachin Buri after residents complained of pollution, pledging that any action would comply with the law.
title_cn: 工业部长责令整治污染投诉
summary_cn: 泰国工业部长瓦拉武·西帕亚因帕兰府（Prachin Buri）民众投诉工业污染，责令对当地工厂进行进一步检查和水质检测，并承诺所有行动都将依法进行。环境污染问题不仅影响当地居民健康和生活质量，也关系到在泰外国人的生活环境和投资安全，需要高度重视和监督。
desc_original: Industry Minister Varawut Silpa-archa on Monday ordered further factory inspections and water sampling in Prachin Buri after residents complained of pollution, pledging that any action would comply with the law.

title: Digital wallets lead to Cambodia scam
desc: Police traced cryptocurrency transactions across dozens of anonymous digital wallets to identify a money-laundering network linked to scam operations in Cambodia, leading to 39 arrests and the seizure of assets worth more than 500 million baht.
title_cn: 数字钱包追踪柬埔寨诈骗网络
summary_cn: 泰国警方通过追踪多个匿名数字钱包中的加密货币交易，成功查获与柬埔寨诈骗活动相关的跨国洗钱网络，逮捕39名嫌疑人，缴获资产超过5亿泰铢。此案反映国际诈骗团伙日益猖獗的现状，也表明泰国正加强执法合作应对跨境犯罪，对投资者和游客安全具有重要意义。
desc_original: Police traced cryptocurrency transactions across dozens of anonymous digital wallets to identify a money-laundering network linked to scam operations in Cambodia, leading to 39 arrests and the seizure of assets worth more than 500 million baht.

title: Toyota allots B1.49bn for pickup plant
desc: Toyota Motor Thailand is set to invest 1.49 billion baht to establish Thailand's first production line for fuel cell electric vehicle (FCEV) pickup trucks, marking a significant step in the country's transition towards cleaner automotive technologies, according to the Board of Investment (BoI).
title_cn: 丰田投资14.9亿泰铢建燃料电池电动皮卡生产线
summary_cn: 丰田泰国公司计划投资14.9亿泰铢在泰国建设首条燃料电池电动车（FCEV）皮卡生产线。这是泰国在清洁汽车技术方面的重要进步，标志着国家向更环保的汽车工业转型。该项目已获泰国投资促进委员会（BoI）批准，将有力推动新能源汽车产业发展。
desc_original: Toyota Motor Thailand is set to invest 1.49 billion baht to establish Thailand's first production line for fuel cell electric vehicle (FCEV) pickup trucks, marking a significant step in the country's transition towards cleaner automotive technologies, according to the Board of Investment (BoI).

title: NSC steps up southern safeguards
desc: The National Security Council (NSC) is stepping up preventive measures in the southern border provinces alongside peace talks, seeking to prevent further incidents and rebuild public trust.
title_cn: 国家安全委员会加强南部边境防控
summary_cn: 泰国国家安全委员会（NSC）正在加强南部边境各省的防控措施，同步推进和平谈判。目标是防止进一步安全事件发生，并重建公众信任。这反映了政府在南部地区安全与和平进程中的平衡策略。
desc_original: The National Security Council (NSC) is stepping up preventive measures in the southern border provinces alongside peace talks, seeking to prevent further incidents and rebuild public trust.

title: BMA apologises for flood relief delays
desc: Bangkok governor Chadchart Sittipunt has apologised to flood-hit residents after applications for financial assistance surged beyond expectations, with more than 1 million claims registered.
title_cn: 曼谷市政府为洪灾救济延迟道歉
summary_cn: 曼谷市长差查特（Chadchart Sittipunt）就洪灾救济申请处理延迟向受灾居民道歉。申请洪灾财政补助的人数激增，已超过100万人，超出预期。此事直接关系在曼谷居住的外国人的生活稳定性和政府救灾能力。
desc_original: Bangkok governor Chadchart Sittipunt has apologised to flood-hit residents after applications for financial assistance surged beyond expectations, with more than 1 million claims registered.

title: New travel  subsidies for tour groups
desc: The government is offering transport subsidies of up to 40,000 baht per trip to encourage domestic group travel and generate at least 208.8 million baht in tourism revenue.
title_cn: 政府推出新的旅游团补贴政策
summary_cn: 泰国政府推出新的旅游补贴政策，为国内团体旅游提供高达4万泰铢的运输补贴。该政策旨在刺激国内旅游消费，预期至少产生2.088亿泰铢的旅游收入。此举对在泰外国人的旅游和商业活动有一定利好影响。
desc_original: The government is offering transport subsidies of up to 40,000 baht per trip to encourage domestic group travel and generate at least 208.8 million baht in tourism revenue.

title: Thailand, Japan explore digital finance cooperation
desc: Thailand and Japan are exploring ways to use digital finance to simplify cross-border payments, boost investment and connect tourism services, with industry leaders proposing a joint super-app and closer cooperation between financial institutions.
title_cn: 泰日探索数字金融合作
summary_cn: 泰国与日本正在探索数字金融合作，以简化跨境支付流程、促进双向投资和连接旅游服务。业界领袖建议建立联合超级应用并加强金融机构间合作。这对在泰日本商人和旅游、投资领域有重要意义，涉及跨境金融创新。
desc_original: Thailand and Japan are exploring ways to use digital finance to simplify cross-border payments, boost investment and connect tourism services, with industry leaders proposing a joint super-app and closer cooperation between financial institutions.

title: Govt 'committed' to protecting territory
desc: Thailand has reaffirmed its commitment to protecting its sovereignty in maritime boundary talks with Cambodia, as the two countries consider measures to ease tensions and keep negotiations on track.
title_cn: 泰国重申在柬埔寨海上边界谈判中保护主权的决心
summary_cn: 泰国在与柬埔寨进行的海洋边界谈判中重申了保护国家主权和领土完整的坚定承诺。两国正在探讨缓和紧张局势、保持谈判顺利进行的相关措施，希望通过持续对话找到互利共赢的解决方案，维护地区和平稳定。
desc_original: Thailand has reaffirmed its commitment to protecting its sovereignty in maritime boundary talks with Cambodia, as the two countries consider measures to ease tensions and keep negotiations on track.

title: Orange Line trials to start late next year
desc: The eastern section of the Orange Line MRT is slated to open for trial runs starting from December next year, with fare collection set to begin in January the following year.
title_cn: 曼谷橙线（Orange Line）东段将于明年底启动试运营
summary_cn: 曼谷MRT橙线东段计划于2027年12月开始试运营，2028年1月正式启动售票系统。该项目是曼谷轨道交通网络扩建的重要组成部分，将进一步优化城市内部交通连接，便利居民和游客出行。
desc_original: The eastern section of the Orange Line MRT is slated to open for trial runs starting from December next year, with fare collection set to begin in January the following year.

title: ลูกชายเส้นเลือดในสมองแตก แม่ตัดสินใจสร้างกุศลสุดท้าย บริจาคอวัยวะช่วย 4 ชีวิต
desc: แม่สร้างกุศลใหญ่ครั้งสุดท้ายให้ลูกชาย หลังเสียชีวิตจาก "เส้นเลือดในสมองแตก" ตัดสินใจ "บริจาคอวัยวะ" ให้ผู้ป่วย 4 ราย ได้มีชีวิตที่ดีขึ้น

title: Rayong police chief reassigned after karaoke bribe claims
desc: Rayong police chief reassigned after karaoke bribe claims Legacy A police chief in Rayong has been reassigned following raids on four unlicensed karaoke venues that prompted allegations of monthly protection bribe payments to government officials. Police Colonel Nawin Sinthurat was ordered to leave his duties at Pluak Daeng Police Station on Saturday, October 17, and report to the Rayong Provincial Police Operations Centre. The order, signed by Rayong Provincial Police Commander Police Major General Pramote Ngampradit, cited concerns about possible police misconduct and damage to the Royal Thai Police’s reputation. According to Thairath, the reassignment was intended to allow a fact-finding investigation to proceed. The order did not establish that Nawin had committed wrongdoing. The decision followed Operation Secret Room, led by Deputy Interior Minister Polpee Suwannachawee and officials from the Department of Provincial Administration earlier that day. Officers inspected four KTV karaoke venues in Pluak Daeng district that primarily catered to Chinese customers. Preliminary checks found that none held the required entertainment venue licences. title: Thailand sets December deadline for nominee land investigations
desc: Thailand sets December deadline for nominee land investigations Legacy Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has ordered a nationwide crackdown on nominee land ownership in Thailand, setting a December deadline for investigations into high-risk cases and demanding the compulsory sale of land found to be illegally held on behalf of foreigners. Anutin announced the three-part campaign today, October 19, at Government House in Bangkok, instructing the Department of Lands and provincial governors to intensify investigations into suspicious property holdings. The crackdown targets arrangements in which Thai individuals or companies hold land on behalf of foreign nationals to circumvent ownership restrictions. Investigators have been ordered to look beyond the names on land title deeds and company records to establish who actually controls the properties and receives the financial benefits. The checks will include examining company ownership structures, financial transactions and asset trails to identify wider networks involved in suspected illegal arrangements. title: Phuket eyes AI system to keep tourists safe
desc: Phuket eyes AI system to keep tourists safe Legacy Phuket officials are considering an AI safety system to identify potential threats to tourists , issue early warnings, and help government agencies respond faster to emergencies . The proposal was discussed on Saturday, October 17, but no budget or launch date has been announced. Phuket Governor Chotnarin Kerdsom met researchers from Walailak University to discuss using artificial intelligence and large-scale data analysis to improve tourist safety, with Phuket proposed as a pilot location. According to The Phuket News, the system would build on existing provincial dashboards, bringing together information on tourism, traffic, waste management and public safety. Photo via Phuket PR Department It would also analyse government records, reports from officials on the ground and social media discussions in multiple languages to identify emerging concerns affecting both Thai and international visitors. A proposed risk map would classify threats into four levels: low, medium, high and critical. Officials could then use the information to identify areas requiring attention and respond “before problems escalate”. Photo via Phuke

summary_cn: 普吉岛官方正与瓦莱拉克大学合作研究AI安全系统，以识别潜在威胁、发出预警并加快应急响应。该系统拟整合旅游、交通、环卫、公共安全等领域数据，分析政府记录和多语言社交媒体讨论，将风险分为低、中、高、严重四个等级。目前仍无确定预算和启动时间，普吉岛被提议作为试点地区，有望在问题扩大前及时介入。

title: 中国籍男子非法入境泰国被捕，曾涉多起电信诈骗案件
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 10月17日，泰国警方在曼谷RCA地区一家餐厅内抓获一名37岁中国籍男子，其涉嫌非法入境泰国且无法出示护照或其他有效旅行证件。此外，该男子还涉嫌电信及互联网诈骗，中国警方正追查其下落。 此前，泰国移民局警方接到举报，称曼谷RCA一带有外国人疑似非法入境，遂派员前往调查并在当地一家餐厅内发现被举报人员。 经由翻译询问，该男子承认自己没有护照或其他有效旅行证件，通过泰老边境自然通道非法进入泰国。其从老挝乘船渡河抵达泰国，随后联系接应人员并支付约10万泰铢请求协助非法入境，全程未经过移民部门检查及许可。 警方核查移民局信息系统后未发现该男子的入境记录。目前，警方已将其移交移民局调查部门，依法进行进一步处理。 此外，泰国警方收到中国有关安全部门的协查信息，称该男子涉嫌参与电信及互联网诈骗犯罪。泰方正与相关部门核实信息，后续将依法处理。 泰国移民局表示，将继续追查协助外国人非法入境的相关人员及犯罪团伙，防止泰国沦为跨国犯罪人员的藏身之所。 （编译：jinda；审校：wan） The post 中国籍男子非法入境泰国被捕，曾涉多起电信诈骗案件 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .
